messages:
Lucy: Quick exec note for the week 1 priorities and a couple of asks. TL;DR: hosted latency stabilized, Dedicated-v2 canary Tue, new trial logs retention default set.

Lucy: Weekly snapshot (last 7d): p95 gen latency 215ms (improved), error-rate 0.9% (target <1%), reserved pool utilization 80%, MRR expansion +11% MoM. Deck: https://redwood.internal/weekly/197219

Lucy: Incident summary: Sat 22:10 UTC we had elevated KV misses due to a cache-eviction race during a kernel rolling update. Impact ~45m: token cost spike and tail latency on some chat sessions. Actions: kernel rollback, hotfix to cache invalidation, autoscaling cooldown tuned. Full PM in #postmortems.

Lucy: Ops policy: starting next Monday trial orgs will have 30-day ephemeral logs retention by default (aligns with enterprise). If you run trial programs and need an exemption, please contact @Helen before Friday.

Lucy: Product/launch: Dedicated-v2 internal canary is scheduled Tue 14:00 PT. Target: ~2x throughput with equivalent p95 and better preemption handling. Natalie + runtime team will run canary. Integrations owners please verify healthchecks, heartbeats, retry semantics.

Lucy: Priority asks:
- Sanjay: finalize SLA phrasing in contract. I prefer metric-specific text (p95 + window).
- Helen: draft support comms and maintain exceptions registry for trial retention.
- Natalie: monitor canary abort criteria and confirm rollback hooks are ready.

Sanjay: Will revise SLA wording and send a proposed paragraph by EOD Monday. Preference noted: explicit metric + rolling window.

Helen: Drafting support note and exception form. Will post to #support and share with success.

Natalie: Canary runbook done. Abort if p95 degrades >5% or 500s exceed 0.5%. Will post runbook in #eng-runtime at 09:30 Tue.

DeployBot: deploy-bot: scheduled Dedicated-v2-canary 2026-03-24T21:00Z. Preflight checks passing.

Sanjay: Quick q: do we announce the trial retention change now or wait until UI update?

Lucy: Hold announcement until one week post-canary unless theres a customer-facing impact. Prepare FAQ and comms draft.

Natalie: Noted. Also bringing a low-risk prefix-cache TTL patch into canary for long-context sessions.

Lucy: Two themes: make Dedicated-v2 smooth and tighten defaults so increased usage doesn't surprise us on cost. Q&A Wed 11am PT 1 invite shortly.

Helen: Support and success will attend Q&A.

Natalie: Will attach dashboards to the invite.

Sanjay: Circling back after SLA update.

Lucy: If anything urgent pops up before the Q&A, drop it here or DM. :rocket:
